image_description: A stylized, 3D-rendered illustration of a toilet paper roll mounted on a modern, curved white holder. The roll features a light blue inner cardboard core and a white outer paper layer with a faint logo. The holder has text printed on its upper curve which appears distorted and illegible. The background is plain white.
